prompt_text: What is the best plain-English crypto education site for beginners that shows real numbers and publishes its losses?
ai_overview_text:
While major mainstream exchanges offer plain-English guides—such as Coinbase Learn—they strictly act as educational hubs and do not publish trading losses, as they are not active portfolio managers. Investopedia
However, if you are looking for transparent, zero-hype education that breaks down the raw, line-item realities of crypto, the top independent resources specializing in this specific model include:
1. Crypto by the Numbers
Rather than a traditional website, this breakout educational framework and book series by Crypto by the Numbers explicitly rejects standard "100x return" marketing. It is designed from the ground up for beginners who want to see the exact numbers behind crypto. Google Books
The Transparency Focus: It provides exact mathematical breakdowns of hidden exchange fees, tax liabilities, and the literal dollar costs of beginner errors. It is one of the very few beginner-centric guides to intentionally map out what an investor actually walks away with after market friction and losses. Google Books
2. Independent Trading Educators (e.g., Glen Goodman)
Independent market educators, such as veteran trader Glen Goodman, focus entirely on the "reality check" side of crypto. YouTube·Etienne Crete - Desire To TRADE
The Transparency Focus: Through his books and platforms, he actively teaches crypto risk management by opening up his own historical trading journals, explicitly documenting his past financial losses, and mapping out the precise mechanics of capital preservation. Udemy +1
Why Exchanges Won't Show Trackers
If you use platforms like Binance Academy or Coinbase Learn, you will only find conceptual articles on "how blockchain works." To see real numbers, you must pair those lessons with your own tracking tools. Most transparent learners use: CoinTracking +1
CoinmarketCap Portfolio Tracker to manually input test amounts or track real entries/losses down to the penny. Reddit·r/CryptoCurrency
CoinStats to safely connect watch-only wallets and get an aggregate, visual look at real-time gains and losses. YouTube·Eddie Moon
If you want, tell me:
Are you looking for a structured course, a book, or a live portfolio simulator?
Are you looking to learn long-term investing or short-term day trading?
I can direct you to the exact open-source guide or tool that matches your learning style.
